caption: Art gallery interior featuring a large green sculpture of two conjoined heads, one male and one female, as the central foreground piece. In the background, several human-form sculptures and spherical works stand on white plinths, arranged around the room under ceiling spotlights on a tiled floor.

Collage-style reinterpretation of “The Birth of Venus,” composed of layered paper fragments. A nude female figure stands on a large scallop shell at center, facing forward. On the left, two airborne figures blow wind toward her. On the right, a robed woman holds out a flowing red cloak. The background includes blue sea, sky, and distant trees, with angular, multicolored scraps forming all figures and surroundings.

Abstract painting with bold blocks and strokes of vivid blue, orange, and red acrylic paint. Thick, overlapping brushstrokes create rectangular and irregular shapes, with blue dominating the central area and warmer tones concentrated around the edges. The texture appears layered and uneven, emphasizing contrast between cool and warm colors. No discernible figures or text are present.

Woman wearing a virtual reality headset and holding a controller stands in front of a large wall display resembling Van Gogh’s “Starry Night.” A nearby computer monitor on a white pedestal shows the same swirling blue and yellow artwork, with cables connecting the headset to the computer. The setting appears to be an indoor exhibition or demo area.

Group of six adults in business-casual clothing stand in a spacious, well-lit art gallery while a man in a dark blazer gestures toward a large vertical-striped abstract painting on the wall. Additional colorful abstract paintings hang in the background, and track lighting runs along the ceiling over the polished wood floor.
